title: NeocorRAG: Less Irrelevant Information, More Explicit Evidence, and More Effective Recall via Evidence Chains
authors: Shiyao Peng; Qianhe Zheng; Zhuodi Hao; Zichen Tang; Rongjin Li; Qing Huang; Jiayu Huang; Jiacheng Liu; Yifan Zhu; Haihong E
why_relevant: Proposes a new metric (Recall Conversion Rate) exposing how retrieved noise/interfering information degrades reasoning, and introduces a method to filter irrelevant/distracting content via evidence chains, directly addressing noisy retrieval and distraction.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on QA quality optimization rather than adversarial or conflict settings.
